recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast close-up of a man and woman in a 1950s-style studio portrait, characterized by a warm, aged paper texture and a distinct cyan-and-red color palette. The woman looks upward with an exaggerated, wide-eyed expression, while the man leans his cheek against her head, looking forward with a neutral, slightly melancholy gaze.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight facial proximity creating a sense of forced intimacy
Contrast between the woman's upward gaze and the man's forward gaze
Juxtaposition of clean, modern script typography against a grainy, vintage photo
Balance between the large-scale faces and the small-scale header text
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot pattern or film grain
High-contrast lighting with soft shadows on the skin
Stylized 1950s hair and makeup (red lipstick, pearl earring)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two faces dominate the frame, filling approximately 80% of the space, positioned slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's eyes and bright red lips serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the woman's face, follows her gaze upward to the script title, then moves across the top header to the man's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily concentrated in the top left corner to accommodate the main title.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan Blue (script title) and Bright Red (lips and header text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated tones for the photo, contrasted by high-saturation primary colors for the graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a four-color process feel (CMYK-inspired)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, upright script and slanted sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a double-line or 'inline' script effect with a drop shadow
Header text is a bold, italicized sans-serif with wide tracking
Script strokes are consistent in weight, resembling a felt-tip marker or neon tube
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders in the script are kept short to maintain a compact block
The 'S' in the script is oversized and serves as a flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of organic, fluid script with rigid, geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script feel
Matches the bold, slanted, condensed header style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1950s studio portrait of a man and woman close together. The woman has dark, styled hair and red lipstick, looking up with wide eyes. The man has short hair and a neutral expression, leaning his face against hers. Use a warm, aged paper texture with a slight halftone effect and high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, cyan-colored casual script title in the top left, slanted upwards at 15 degrees with a grey offset outline. Add a small, all-caps, red sans-serif header across the top edge with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Does the script have a double-line or offset outline effect?
Is the woman's lipstick a vibrant red?
Is the top text widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the cyan and red accents
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
Exact facial features of the original models

mustAchieve: Clean, vector-like quality for the typography
avoid: Generic system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cyan script does not obscure the woman's eyes
Check that the red header text is legible against the background
Verify the 'aged' look doesn't make the image look muddy
Confirm the composition feels 'crowded' in a deliberate, kitschy way
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast 1950s melodrama portrait with a two-tone (Cyan/Red) graphic overlay featuring slanted script and wide-tracked sans-serif headers.
